description: Backend retention phase: Room.retention sub-phase of LOBBY, RETAIN_PLAYER / FINALIZE_RETENTIONS / RESET_RETENTIONS commands, retained players as 15 Cr SOLD purchases (acquisitionType RETENTION), guards on start/join/leave/kick/settings, assertRoom invariants, ROOM_STATE.retention + events, retention player search route, write-behind auction_retentions ledger. Depends on FEAT-001. See plan.md D1, D2, D6, D7, D8.
steps: Create backend/src/domain/retention.ts (RETENTION_PRICE_CR=15, RETENTION_MAX_PER_TEAM=3, RETENTION_MIN_PER_TEAM=0). Extend backend/src/domain/types.ts: Purchase gets optional acquisitionType ('AUCTION'|'RETENTION') and isRetained; Room gets optional `retention?: {phase:'OPEN'|'FINALIZED'; picks: {id, teamId, playerId, priceUnits, at, userId}[]; finalizedAt?: number}`.

Create backend/src/modules/retention/retention.service.ts with pure functions on a draft Room: retainPlayer (checks in plan D7 order; error codes RETENTION_NOT_ENABLED, RETENTION_CLOSED, RETENTION_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND 404, ALREADY_RETAINED_BY_TEAM, PLAYER_ALREADY_RETAINED, RETENTION_LIMIT_REACHED, SQUAD_FULL, INSUFFICIENT_PURSE; effects: Purchase of 30 units with acquisitionType RETENTION, team.spentUnits += 30, team.playerIds push, room.players gets the player as SOLD round 0 with recomputed base price), finalizeRetentions, resetRetentions (removes purchases/players/ids, restores spend, phase OPEN), releaseTeamRetentions (used by kick/leave before finalize). Use requireThat/DomainError like the rest of the engine.

auction.schemas.ts: add RETAIN_PLAYER {playerId} and host commands FINALIZE_RETENTIONS, RESET_RETENTIONS to commandSchema. auction.engine.ts: handle RETAIN_PLAYER in a member-level branch before the host-only else (await manager.fc26.get(playerId) inside mutate), FINALIZE/RESET in the host switch; START_AUCTION throws RETENTION_NOT_FINALIZED (409) when settings.retention.enabled and phase !== 'FINALIZED', pool excludes retained ids; KICK_MEMBER releases picks (blocked after finalize with RETENTION_FINALIZED); END_AUCTION from LOBBY resets retentions; UPDATE_SETTINGS and room.service.updateSettings throw RETENTION_LOCKED (409) when startingBudgetCr, retention.enabled or playerPoolSource change while picks exist or phase is FINALIZED; room.service.join/leave respect the finalized lock and release picks on leave before finalize. Push events PLAYER_RETAINED, RETENTION_FINALIZED, RETENTION_RESET (+ TEAM_UPDATED, BUDGET_UPDATED). Receipts/idempotency stay as for other commands.

squad.service.ts assertRoom: add retention invariants only when room.retention exists (picks unique by player and by pick id, <=3 per team, each pick has a matching RETENTION purchase of 30 units and a SOLD room.player, picks only when settings.retention.enabled, FINALIZED only with the room past OPEN).

room-state.ts and teams/team.service.ts: add `retention` to roomState ({enabled, config:{priceCr,maxPerTeam,minPerTeam}, phase 'OFF'|'OPEN'|'FINALIZED', picks with public player snapshot and priceCr, per-team {teamId, retainedCount, remainingSlots, spentCr, remainingPurseCr}, totals}); soldPlayers entries carry acquisitionType/isRetained; publicTeam adds retainedCount, retentionSpentCr, auctionPurseCr. Existing fields keep their shape and values.

Add GET /api/rooms/:code/retention/players to fc26.routes.ts (member-only, query search/group/offset/limit<=100, excludes retained players, uses catalog.search with excludeIds from room.retention.picks).

Create backend/src/modules/retention/retention.ledger.ts: `RetentionLedger` interface, in-memory implementation (enforces unique room/player) and PostgresRetentionLedger (idempotent full sync per room into auction_retentions, resolving football_players.id by fc26_player_id; errors logged, never thrown into the room commit). Subscribe it via manager.subscribe in app.ts for commits whose events include retention events, and sync recovered rooms at boot. Update backend/WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL.md and AUCTION_RULES.md.

Tests in backend/tests/retention.test.ts using fixture() with an FC26 memory catalog: retain 0/1/2/3 players; 4th blocked; exactly 30 units/15 Cr; insufficient purse blocked; same player by two teams (sequential and Promise.all concurrent => exactly one success); player not in catalog rejected; squad max respected; retained players absent from queue/ACTIVE across a whole auction run (loop NEXT/expire until round ends) and from recall; retention OFF skips the phase and START works as before; START blocked before finalize with RETENTION_NOT_FINALIZED, works after; purses reflect deductions (spent, remaining, auctionPurse); reset restores purses and clears picks and squads; non-host cannot finalize/reset; settings locked after picks; kick/leave releases picks; join blocked after finalize; ROOM_STATE.retention content; bidding, sold and unsold still work after retention; full flow Create settings -> join -> retain -> finalize -> start -> bid -> sold; in-memory ledger rejects duplicate (room,player).
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend; npx vitest run tests/retention.test.ts` passes, including the concurrent same-player retain case
`cd backend; npx vitest run` shows only the 6 pre-existing failures
Retention OFF rooms: START_AUCTION and all existing commands behave exactly as before
A finalized retained player never appears as ACTIVE, WAITING, UNSOLD, in playerQueue or recall
Starting before FINALIZE_RETENTIONS is rejected by the backend; only the host can finalize or reset
verification: cd backend; npx vitest run tests/retention.test.ts
cd backend; npx vitest run (only the 6 baseline failures allowed)
findings:
Verification: backend tsc --noEmit exit 0; vitest tests/retention.test.ts = 35/35 pass (incl. concurrent same-player retain: exactly 1 success). Full vitest runs: run 1 = 253 pass / 10 fail under load (skip-vote x5, integration skip-voting x1 = baseline, plus manager-mode 'automatically completes seasons', host-reports transfers and seasons timeouts); run 2 = 256 pass / 7 fail (baseline 6 + manager-mode seasons timeout). tests/manager-mode.test.ts + host-reports.test.ts + seasons.test.ts pass alone (25/25), so those are the known load-flaky timeouts, not regressions. Only the 6 baseline failures are real (skip-vote.test.ts x5, integration.test.ts skip-voting x1).
Files: domain/retention.ts {RETENTION_PRICE_CR=15, RETENTION_PRICE_UNITS=30, RETENTION_MAX_PER_TEAM=3, RETENTION_MIN_PER_TEAM=0}. domain/types.ts: Purchase.acquisitionType/isRetained, RetentionPick, RoomRetention, Room.retention?. modules/retention/retention.service.ts {retainPlayer, finalizeRetentions, resetRetentions, releaseTeamRetentions, requireRetentionOpenForMembership, assertRetentionSettingsUnlocked, syncRetentionWithSettings, retentionPhase, teamPicks, retentionSpentUnits}. modules/retention/retention.ledger.ts {RetentionLedger, InMemoryRetentionLedger(rows(roomId)), PostgresRetentionLedger(sql).setLogger, hasRetentionEvents, ledgerRows}. buildApp option etentionLedger; server.ts builds PostgresRetentionLedger when managerDb exists (silent no-op logging once per error code until the migration is applied). tests/retention.test.ts.
Wire contract for FEAT-003: WS commands RETAIN_PLAYER {roomCode, playerId}, FINALIZE_RETENTIONS, RESET_RETENTIONS {roomCode}. Events PLAYER_RETAINED {pickId, teamId, playerId, priceCr, retainedCount, remainingBudgetCr}, RETENTION_FINALIZED {totalRetained, totalSpentCr}, RETENTION_RESET {removed|teamId, reason?} (plus TEAM_UPDATED/BUDGET_UPDATED). Errors (WS ERROR.reason / REST error.code): RETENTION_NOT_ENABLED, RETENTION_CLOSED, RETENTION_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND(404), ALREADY_RETAINED_BY_TEAM, PLAYER_ALREADY_RETAINED, RETENTION_LIMIT_REACHED, SQUAD_FULL, INSUFFICIENT_PURSE, RETENTION_NOT_FINALIZED (START), RETENTION_FINALIZED (join/leave/kick after finalize), RETENTION_LOCKED (settings). All 409 except noted.
ROOM_STATE.retention = {enabled, config:{priceCr,maxPerTeam,minPerTeam}, phase:'OFF'|'OPEN'|'FINALIZED', picks:[{id,teamId,playerId,priceCr,at,player: public player|null}], teams:[{teamId,retainedCount,remainingSlots,spentCr,remainingPurseCr}], totals:{retained,spentCr}, finalizedAt|null}. Team DTOs (teams[], currentUserTeam, results, team detail, join/create responses) gained retainedCount, retentionSpentCr, auctionPurseCr (additive; publicTeam(team, settings, room.retention)). soldPlayers entries gained acquisitionType ('AUCTION'|'RETENTION') and isRetained. Retained players appear in ROOM_STATE.players with status SOLD, round 0.
REST: GET /api/rooms/:code/retention/players?search&group(ALL|GK|CB|FB|CM|WM|ST|W)&offset&limit<=100 (members only, 403 for outsiders) -> {total, offset, limit, retentionPriceCr, players:[publicPlayer + retentionPriceCr + retainedByTeamId:null]}; retained players are excluded. registerFc26Routes(app, catalog, manager).
Behavior notes/deviations: retention record is created lazily on first retain/finalize/reset (rooms with retention enabled but no activity have room.retention undefined and phase reads as OPEN). Switching retention off with no picks deletes the empty record. RETENTION_RESET is also emitted when a team with picks leaves/is kicked and when the lobby is closed with picks. START_AUCTION gate is etentionPhase !== 'OPEN' (OFF and FINALIZED pass). Retain purse check is remaining purse >= 15 Cr only (no min-squad reserve check), as in plan D7. Docs: WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL.md and AUCTION_RULES.md updated. Migration still NOT applied; no SQL run against any database.
